results.title: Strategic insights for entrepreneurship and business growth in the ...
results.content: Santander – Colombia in one of the most important department of the country due to the latest measurement in competitiveness index, this study offers a comprehensive analysis of Santander, Colombia’s export sector from 2010 to 2020, utilizing regional opportunity map data to identify trends and growth patterns. Its contribution lies in its decade-long examination of the export sector, using financial and regression approaches to elucidate the relationship between company size, economic activity, financial indicators, and business growth, while also anticipating the implications of future trade agreements for the region. In the study of exporting companies in Santander (Colombia), authors propose internationalisation strategies related to: the development of products or services of international stature, investment and negotiation processes with destination countries, and also the manager’s attitude towards managing uncertainty when promoting internationalisation as a valid business strategy (Mujica & Velasco, 2016. The significant variables that explain the business growth of exporting firms in Santander are size, current ratio, debt level, whether the firm is a limited joint-stock, and whether the firm belongs to the Wholesale and retail trade, repair of motor vehicles and motorbikes sector.
